concepts.title: Planner and durable supervisor
concepts.rationale: Use the already shared architectural overview rather than maintain another full journey. Keep the local drafting, frontier and assembly detail figures. The legacy direct review-to-dispatch arrow bypasses the now-explicit steering decision.

concepts.title: Parent run versus WorkPlan state and recovery
concepts.rationale: Preserve inline state notation, but split parent status from plan status and show assembly_steering, durable in_review recovery and recoverable assembly_blocked. RAI RED now parks at human review, not a terminal RaiBlocked sink; review changes are not unconditional redispatch.

concepts.title: Dispatchable roster admission and intent breadth
concepts.rationale: Keep layered team admission, trusted capability context and narrow-versus-broad goal guidance as prose; a separate roster admission graphic would duplicate the planner story.

concepts.title: Draft, revise, confirm and decline
concepts.rationale: Legacy graph correctly funnels confirm/decline through finalization and revision back through draft; orchestration must remain explicitly guarded by confirmed status. Keep the autopilot confirmation attribution in prose.

concepts.title: Trigger-agnostic selection and post-decomposition compatibility
concepts.rationale: Replace the obsolete trigger-eligibility algorithm with a reference to the shared selection canonical. Current selection accepts all available definitions, checks explicit choices before the singleton fast path and can reselect automatic code-producing plans after decomposition. Do not draw a second selector.

concepts.title: Outcome-complete decomposition and durable DAG
concepts.rationale: Keep parsing normalization, deterministic fallback, cycle repair and workflow-as-guidance explanations textual. The outcome's breadth, not a minimal stage count, controls the plan; the rebuilding checklist's minimal-DAG wording should align.

concepts.title: Model selection and provider boundary
concepts.rationale: Correct the absolute GitHubCopilot-only child claim before authoring. Dispatch now resolves the effective project model provider; preserve model-pin versus role-default explanation only where verified for that provider.

concepts.title: Ready frontier and terminal eligibility
concepts.rationale: The legacy Child terminal? diamond has an unconditional outgoing edge and no continue-observing path. Add nonterminal observation, pending-capacity/stall recovery, and distinguish quiescence from successful assembly eligibility.

concepts.title: Dispatch and assembly leases, fencing and integration lock
concepts.rationale: Keep the detailed ownership/status predicates and configuration values textual beside the frontier. A separate distributed-lock diagram is unnecessary in this bounded catalog; foreground that repository sharing is not a shared mutable child checkout.

concepts.title: Child workspaces and prerequisite publication
concepts.rationale: Replace shared-orchestration-worktree assertions with isolated child execution checkouts, authoritative child branches and dependency-base publication. Reuse the git integration canonical after its correction.

concepts.title: Replay, human waits, stall redispatch and topology projection
concepts.rationale: Retain correlated child observation and topology details as prose, linked to the shared replay concept. Update the stale first-stall-fails summary to match the bounded redispatch subsection and preserve approval/provisioning wait exemptions.

concepts.title: Collective assembly, authored gates, review and completion
concepts.rationale: Repair disconnected parser-artifact nodes such as by, Test, detached and ready. Show workflow-derived gate order and applicability, isolated review/build worktree, nonblocking preview, durable review, visible steering and RAI RED escalation. Separate retryable infrastructure parks from terminal failures.

concepts.title: Restart routing and bounded cleanup
concepts.rationale: Keep a table rather than another recovery graphic. InReview resumes the persisted review without rebuilding/re-running reviewed stages; retain draft/Scribe timeouts and heartbeat/reaper text, and remove the old in-memory-only recovery rationale.

concepts.title: Operator recovery and request-changes choices
concepts.rationale: Use the normalized signal/decision canonical rather than repeating legacy feedback-inference and reset recipes. Scoped files are structured hints, and resume versus fresh execution is an explicit decision.

concepts.title: Per-run branches, worktrees and reviewed tree identity
concepts.rationale: Keep this distinct content-isolation view, but connect producer outputs through commit/tree/diff to the currently disconnected ReviewA/ReviewB nodes. Replace raw node-id labels and show guarded merge back into the originating branch.

concepts.title: Candidate commit, review and guarded merge states
concepts.rationale: Retain the inline state model as a conceptual lifecycle, explicitly labeling CommittingCandidate as an operation rather than a persisted RunStatus. The reviewed hash and recoverable blocked merge are verified.

concepts.title: Repository provisioning and scope-independent capture
concepts.rationale: Keep deterministic branch naming, stage-all-nonignored capture, nested-repository handling and no-empty-commit behavior in prose; the branch/worktree graphic is sufficient.

concepts.title: Dependency branch propagation and final aggregate
concepts.rationale: Retain the unique git-content view, add isolated child branches and the dependent-child base, and represent authored collective gates abstractly. Correct prose that all integration conflicts stop: current assembly accepts later-child changes when a merge base exists and emits the auto-resolution.

concepts.title: Local merge versus optional GitHub pull-request action
concepts.rationale: Remove the absolute claim that opening PRs is out of scope. open_pull_request is a deterministic capability-backed workflow action; do not infer branch-push behavior from the PR action. Keep local git and remote publication as separate boundaries, with no new graphic.

concepts.title: Dirty-base protection, cleanup and recovery
concepts.rationale: Keep the detailed operational cases textual. Correct the ref-only trade-off: checked-out dirty origin must reconcile losslessly or block; ref-only updates apply only when that branch is not checked out. Also remove the shared-child-worktree gotcha.

concepts.title: Proposals, provenance, promotion and bounded context
concepts.rationale: Keep the governance lifecycle distinct from prompt selection, but expose verified run/owner provenance, approved policy and cross-team trust gates. Active status alone must not appear sufficient to enter authoritative prompt context.

concepts.title: Decision, inbox, memory and session relationships
concepts.rationale: Keep the ER model and uniqueness constraints as inline notation. Label PROJECT ownership as conceptual cross-store ownership, not a claim that every drawn relationship is an enforced foreign key.

concepts.title: Pending, merged and rejected state
concepts.rationale: Keep the small state model but qualify the pending idempotent update with matching source kind and source identity, not only same agent and slug. Promotion remains transactional and rejection retains history.

concepts.title: Collision-safe inbox handles
concepts.rationale: The numbered candidate path currently goes directly to create; it must loop through availability checks. Add provenance equality to the update branch and retain the database unique constraint as concurrency backstop, without claiming automatic retry after a racing insert.

concepts.title: Decisions versus memories and prompt selection
concepts.rationale: Continue reusing the shared compiler canonical. Coordinator should ensure it includes approved architectural/scope decisions, nonlegacy same-agent memory, approved cross-team memory and the untrusted JSON envelope; table/prose remains the authority explanation.

concepts.title: Database authority and one-way exports with inbox union import
concepts.rationale: Retain the asymmetric import/export view, add patterns.md and qualify memory.db as the SQLite deployment rather than universal storage. Only inbox files import; all exported files are not bidirectional stores.

concepts.title: Governance history, trust failures and backup scope
concepts.rationale: Keep additive history, best-effort mirrors, legacy exclusion and backup coverage as prose. No additional CRDT or backup diagram is warranted: the page explicitly does not claim a full CRDT.

concepts.title: Two orchestration responsibility layers
concepts.rationale: Keep the existing shared overview, with planner intent versus run gate execution explicitly separated. Pilot assets remain strictly untouched; this is reference reuse, not a visual certification.

concepts.title: Outcome confirmation lifecycle
concepts.rationale: The compact state model is useful beside the intent contract and agrees with draft/finalize persistence. It is not a second full coordinator journey.

concepts.title: Persisted WorkPlan and dependency ordering
concepts.rationale: Retain the illustrative two-branch DAG; it communicates dependency order rather than an actual fixed four-subtask plan. The separately detailed frontier handles runtime scheduling.

concepts.title: Persist-before-dispatch control sequence
concepts.rationale: Retain the temporal persist/dispatch handoff view: it complements the responsibility overview and static DAG rather than duplicating either. Clarify that auto-confirm is an alternate to the human response.

concepts.title: Child publication and assembly handoff
concepts.rationale: Remove the nonexistent Child safety gate. Current child graph is agent to assemble-ready or typed turn-failed; collective RAI belongs to the parent. Keep dependency-base rebuild and distinguish all settled from all eligible.

concepts.title: Default standalone run pipeline
concepts.rationale: Keep the shared standalone default and identify it as one workflow, not mandatory assembly policy for all runs. Children intentionally bypass this graph.

concepts.title: Invocation, selection and fail-closed binding
concepts.rationale: Use the shared selection explanation. Remove contradictory trigger-eligibility claims in pickup and gotchas; entry triggers start backlog work, whereas the selector considers valid available workflows.

concepts.title: Run states across standalone and child paths
concepts.rationale: Keep the conceptual run state diagram and explain that it is not exhaustive. AssembleReady is a child terminal; blocked merge re-enters review, distinct from terminal merge failure.

concepts.title: Execution, watch-loop projection and event output
concepts.rationale: Retain the runtime temporal view, distinct from the engine's component graph. Treat Watch-to-Orchestrator as status-persistence responsibility, not a claim of a direct method call.

concepts.title: Durable event replay and live tail
concepts.rationale: Keep one shared replay/tail canonical, not another local stream architecture. Preserve parent/child correlation in nearby observation prose.

concepts.title: Backlog state versus projected run lifecycle
concepts.rationale: Consolidate the inline backlog lifecycle with the shared board canonical, explicitly separating persisted Backlog/Ready/Claimed from card states projected from its run. Running/Completed/Failed are not additional BacklogTaskState enum values.

concepts.title: Pickup, reconciliation and pod reaping
concepts.rationale: Move reconciliation outside the per-project fragment to match the service and add periodic reaper phase. Describe unattended confirmation as autopilot-dependent, not unconditional pickup behavior.

concepts.title: Legacy project review-policy overlay
concepts.rationale: Do not publish a configurable overlay that is absent from the current runtime. Replace this subsection with workflow-declared gates and binding, retaining review safety without asserting an active policy registry/composer.

concepts.title: Durable review pause and resume
concepts.rationale: Reuse the corrected review API sequence instead of a second sequence that shows the client directly resuming the workflow and bypasses durable decision arbitration.

concepts.title: Recovery, merge and Scribe responsibilities
concepts.rationale: Keep the compact recovery checklist and casting boundary textual. They explain why persisted state, atomic pickup, guarded merge and recorded outcomes matter without adding another architecture.

concepts.title: Bounded revision, escalation and human reset
concepts.rationale: Retain this specialized convergence loop, but route resumable request-changes to in-place revision too: rejection does not always rotate. Label escalation completely, fix mojibake, and show normal successful gate progress to review. The legacy graph only labels in-place as advisory/non-rejection.

concepts.title: Operator verbs at durable review gates
concepts.rationale: Keep redirect/amend as delivered request-changes, send as advisory, and cross-replica deferred delivery in prose. Preserve the assembly loop's single-writer boundary; no extra HTTP routing graphic is necessary.

concepts.title: Typed child failure terminals and accumulated feedback
concepts.rationale: Keep the success/failure conditional edge contract and context-preserving recovery textual; the small edge list already explains the invariant precisely. Current child graph carries richer typed failure evidence as well as commit failures.

concepts.title: Implicated authors versus dependent rebuild closure
concepts.rationale: The two-set table is clearer than a new DAG: implicated authors may rotate; transitive dependents rebuild without blame. Retain structured TARGET_FILES and observable all-contributors fallback, not prose inference.

concepts.title: Resumability-aware rotation and single-author fallback
concepts.rationale: Preserve the degrade/escalate table, but qualify strict-lockout prose: resumable rejected targets can stay with their author. Nonresumable single-eligible targets with context dispatch fresh under the same author; exhaustion still escalates.

concepts.title: Structured RAI verdict and collective safety escalation
concepts.rationale: Keep sentinel parsing explanation but correct the claim that collective RED terminalizes via RaiBlockAsync. Current assembly explicitly parks RED at accountable human review with reason rai_red. Distinguish this from standalone RAI terminal behavior.

concepts.title: Review accepts a tree; merge enforces repository guards
concepts.rationale: Keep the distinct review-versus-merge mental model, replacing Project review policy -> Effective workflow with workflow-declared gates. Scope this to a review-bearing standalone pipeline rather than promise every custom workflow has human approval.

concepts.title: Legacy configurable policy composition
concepts.rationale: The claimed project policy registry, loader and composer are absent; effective workflow resolution returns the selected workflow directly and blueprints accept only default. Remove the misleading overlay graphic and rewrite the affected policy section as declared gates/bindability, not configurable policy injection.

concepts.title: Standalone review lifecycle
concepts.rationale: Retain inline review states with the scope explicitly standalone/default. Blocked merge returns to awaiting review; failed merge preserves inspection state.

concepts.title: API review arbitration, revision and guarded merge sequence
concepts.rationale: Make this the canonical decision sequence. Repository lock precedes merge CAS, not follows it; request-changes transitions before pending removal on the local path. Distinguish deferred cross-replica decisions and direct fallback from live workflow resumption.

concepts.title: Owner-scoped review and competing decisions
concepts.rationale: Fold pending consumption, CAS and losing replay into the canonical API sequence. A separate figure titled lockout risks conflating human review authorization with coordinator author rotation; preserve that distinction in prose.

concepts.title: One aggregate review rather than per-child approvals
concepts.rationale: Use the corrected collective assembly canonical. The legacy sequence hardcodes RAI/human-only gates and unconditional inferred-subtask reset; current assembly has authored gates, resumable steering, durable review recovery and scoped dependent closure.

concepts.title: Repository lock, merge CAS and classified result
concepts.rationale: Retain the focused lock-before-CAS decision graph. Add prose that recoverable blocked/error outcomes revert to awaiting_review and distinguish parent completion from standalone merged status.

concepts.title: Direct fallback, revision endpoint and failure trade-offs
concepts.rationale: Keep review/merge operational failure cases textual; direct fallback cannot reconstruct request-changes and returns a conflict. Remove obsolete policy-registry failure cases alongside the removed overlay, and correct 'merge target is integration branch': it is the source merged into originating branch.

concepts.title: Proposal-first casting with confirmation write boundary
concepts.rationale: Keep the high-level compiler view: model-assisted selection remains distinct from deterministic naming and confirmed file writes. It has no identified semantic defect at that abstraction.

concepts.title: Blueprint, role, proposal, team and event history
concepts.rationale: Keep the conceptual class diagram; label review_policy as retained default-only metadata rather than a selectable custom registry. Add TeamRevision only if the diagram becomes a concurrency contract rather than a conceptual model.

concepts.title: Scenario, manual and free-text inputs
concepts.rationale: Keep the converging input descriptions textual; separate per-input diagrams would duplicate the existing casting compiler. Trusted catalog recompilation remains an important amendment boundary.

concepts.title: Bounded repository signals into role selection
concepts.rationale: Retain the unique signal-summary privacy boundary and catalog validation path. Universe selection is separate; raw repository sources are not sent as the role-selection summary.

concepts.title: Library/custom/default workflow fallback and blueprint application
concepts.rationale: Keep application/rollback as prose, correct review policy validation to default-only and retain library-first/custom-second/default-last workflow fallback. No separate blueprint diagram is necessary on this casting page.

concepts.title: Deterministic universe, reserved names and overflow
concepts.rationale: Keep the algorithms as ordered lists; seed/history/allowlist and member-N overflow are clearer in prose than another allocation graph.

concepts.title: Catalog and bespoke charter compilation
concepts.rationale: Keep charter provenance and trusted recompilation textual, without reusing the workflow role-lane graphic as though it were casting identity.

concepts.title: Confirmation intents, revision guard and file/event writes
concepts.rationale: Keep the detailed transaction-like flow but add BeginTeamMutationAsync with proposal.TeamRevision and the current-team conflict exit before writes. Preserve new/augment/recast, built-ins, append events and best-effort memory seed; do not imply an atomic filesystem/database transaction.

concepts.title: Proposal lifetime and event-sourced identity files
concepts.rationale: Keep event-sidecar/canonical-snapshot layout and path safety as prose. Qualify proposal persistence by provider: PostgreSQL uses EfCastProposalStore, SQLite uses the local CastProposalStore; short-lived does not necessarily mean memory-only.

concepts.title: Reviewed .squad-only git sync
concepts.rationale: Keep the prefix and expected-hash algorithm textual; unlike run capture, this path intentionally commits only .squad files.

concepts.title: Shared memory import/export and initial seed
concepts.rationale: Reuse the memory mirror canonical after correction rather than add a casting-local import/export figure. Keep only the casting-specific best-effort core-context/session seed here.

concepts.title: Feedback normalization and visibility before effect
concepts.rationale: Keep one normalized steering canonical but change Proceed / terminal to durable human-review escalation for assembly budget exhaustion and qualify source integrations. The signal schema describes agent-originated integration as future-ready rather than proving every source has a production trigger.

concepts.title: Four directions and assembly actions
concepts.rationale: Keep a compact direction table but remove the stale assertion that exhausted budgets write terminal assembly_blocked. Current Proceed opens durable human review; rejection may still resume in place.

concepts.title: Released pods, warm pools and single-eligible fallback
concepts.rationale: Keep probe distinctions, but correct the claim that the first single-agent rejection immediately reaches human review. Context-bearing single-eligible targets degrade to bounded same-author fresh dispatch; warm resumable targets stay in place.

concepts.title: Typed failures, effect markers and human-reset budgets
concepts.rationale: Replace handled commit-failure rethrow claims with the typed child-turn-failed graph and include human-only budget reset. Preserve attempt-specific effect markers and visible fallback, referring to the resilient-loop canonical rather than drawing another retry graph.

concepts.title: Declarative graph, runtime executors and durable recovery
concepts.rationale: Retain engine architecture but identify the shown agent/RAI/review/merge/Scribe chain as the default, not universal. Replace FileSystemJsonCheckpointStore-only storage with provider-aware checkpoint storage and durable pending decisions.

concepts.title: YAML fields versus executable graph
concepts.rationale: Retain the schema-to-binding mental model; fields remain graph data and runtime bindability is a separate check. The node vocabulary belongs in the adjacent table/list rather than stuffing every node into this figure.

concepts.title: Supported node types and extension points
concepts.rationale: Keep a compact textual vocabulary, add the current agent-backed publish node, and distinguish loadable schema extension points from bindable executors. open_pull_request is deterministic and failed creation passes through the produced output.

concepts.title: Traversal order and code-dependent gate applicability
concepts.rationale: Use the corrected assembly canonical for the visual explanation. Keep happy-path traversal, deduplication and non-code Build/Test omission in prose; do not imply YAML declaration order or universal Build/Test.

concepts.title: Built-in default pipeline
concepts.rationale: Keep one shared default workflow illustration. It does not establish a separately configurable project review-policy overlay.

concepts.title: Render metadata versus execution identity/charter
concepts.rationale: Separate role/kind render metadata from agent/charter execution context. The legacy Lane -> Runtime arrow implies the lane selects a role. Preserve node-specific execution distinctions rather than assert every prompt node resolves a catalog agent identically.

concepts.title: Built-in, catalog and project workflow discovery
concepts.rationale: Retain source/validation/filter/cache overview. Correct nearby prose that all reserved-id project copies are invalid: a materialized default id is silently skipped, while other reserved catalog ids conflict. Include signature-based cache refresh in caption/prose.

concepts.title: Run origin does not filter workflow candidates
concepts.rationale: Preserve the canonical boundary but describe actual RunOrigin rather than the no-longer-present WorkflowInvocationKind/ResolveInvocationKind API. Move override/fallback detail to canonical-workflow-selection and show event/schedule producers as implemented upstream backlog inputs, not future automation.

concepts.title: Verified webhook to matching Ready backlog tasks
concepts.rationale: Keep the trust boundary as a numbered pipeline; correct the old project-scoped-secret endpoint description to the current Repo App webhook route and configured key verification. Do not add a near-duplicate ingress architecture.

concepts.title: Unsaved workflow generation with one correction pass
concepts.rationale: Retain the fully inspected nested valid/invalid sequence: both initial and corrected YAML use loader/binder validation, exactly one correction is allowed, and generation returns a draft rather than writes project files.

concepts.title: Explicit choices, automatic selection and post-plan revalidation
concepts.rationale: Continue shared ownership, but request its correction for conversational singleton overrides, explicit-selection events and post-decomposition Build/Test compatibility. The engine prose omits the request dialog override and must align.

concepts.title: Type-based node and transition expansion
concepts.rationale: Retain the binder safety boundary: classified nodes and transition families produce executors/plumbing or a binding exception. Keep unsupported start/transition examples textual rather than another graph.

concepts.title: Obsolete configurable review-policy transform
concepts.rationale: Remove this second consumer of the obsolete overlay; describe workflow gate binding and selected-definition resolution directly. Historical policy-prefixed executor plumbing is not proof of a live project policy composer.

concepts.title: Predicate and generation safety contracts
concepts.rationale: Keep the curated predicate vocabulary, boolean composition and fenced generated-trigger examples as prose/code, not an invented general expression-language graphic. Verified webhook data reaches trigger evaluation only after signature validation.

concepts.title: Canonical workflow-selection algorithm
concepts.rationale: Shared owner must reconcile this consumer's out-of-date algorithm: explicit and conversational overrides precede singleton handling and emit selection events; unavailable dialog override continues normal selection, not automatic default. Automatic selections also undergo code-producing decomposition compatibility.

concepts.title: Override precedence and selection-event exceptions
concepts.rationale: Keep the terse precedence chain as text. Qualify its fallback behavior and the never-emits-for-singletons claim: available explicit choices emit before the count check. Add post-decomposition automatic reselection and explicit missing-Build/Test warning as a separate step, not a precedence level.

concepts.title: Process-fit prompt and deterministic model fallback
concepts.rationale: Keep model authority bounded to supplied candidate definitions and project-default fallback. The canonical algorithm is the single visual; do not generate a second prompt-selection graphic.

concepts.title: Trigger producers versus selector eligibility
concepts.rationale: Reference the corrected invocation boundary: RunOrigin is not candidate filtering, and event/schedule automation is implemented, not entirely future work. Remove references to nonexistent WorkflowInvocationKind/ResolveInvocationKind APIs.

findings.subject: Git integration prose understates remote actions and misstates conflicts
findings.detail: open_pull_request exists and uses a scoped repository credential; this does not prove automatic branch pushing. Integration build resolves conflicts by accepting child changes when a merge base exists, whereas final merge conflicts remain distinct. Checked-out dirty origin branches reconcile losslessly or block, not ref-only advance.
